title: Väddö tungsten fragment from 1957 car stop

tellings.quote:
In 1957, two carpenters were driving
their car in the middle of the night
really because they were doing some work
on Monday. This was Sunday and suddenly
they saw this object coming from east
moving in front of the car making a
Uturn and suddenly hanging in front of
the car which was totally died.

plain: Clas Svahn, a Swedish UFO researcher who keeps a large archive of cases, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about two carpenters driving at night on Väddö, northeast of Stockholm, in 1957. He says they saw an object come in from the east, make a U-turn and hover in front of their car, which then died completely. The case is linked to a small piece of tungsten, a very hard metal, which would be physical evidence if it came from the object.
